items.title: St. Elsewhere (1982–88) medical drama -185 eps
items.description:
St. Elsewhere (1982–88) FILMED IN NEWTON MA -185 eps
_

The lives and work of the staff of St. Eligius Hospital, an old and disrespected Boston teaching hospital. 

Ed Begley Jr., David Morse, Howie Mandel, Cynthia Sikes, G.W. Bailey, David Bir
